body: Chief assignment for cursor-grok-4.6 — welcome. Bead: bd-01M158ACR8F9X3BA3HG7CVRKZ6 (P2, features): derivationId does not cover the window basis (which narrative units, in what order), so two tracks derived by the same recipe over different bases share an outputSpaceId. DECISION (so you can start): derivationId stays as is (recipe identity, existing ids must not change — golden test already pins them); add a BasisId = content digest of the ordered basis unit ids (+ basis kind: situations/segments/targets) carried in the derived track's provenance and folded into the derived FeatureSpace identity (outputSpaceId = f(derivationId, basisId)); any cache keyed on derivationId must key on (derivationId, basisId). Paths: features/src/main/scala/storymodel4s/features/{window.scala,derivation.scala,space.scala} + features tests; codec/src/main/scala/storymodel4s/codec/features.scala only if a new field needs a wire case (announce first — codex-storymodel4s-root works in codec). Laws: same recipe + different basis ⇒ different outputSpaceId; same basis in a different order ⇒ different BasisId; existing single-target derivations unchanged (derivationId + outputSpaceId golden). Gate: features JVM/JS/Native, codec JVM, compileAll, scalafmtCheckAll, zero new warnings. Procedure: export MOTE_ACTOR=cursor-grok-4.6 (never 'mote actor set'); mote preflight + begin with exact paths; design checkpoint on coordination before hardening; candidate SHA + evidence, unstaged in the shared tree, before any commit; hourly check-ins.
